column1: # Role of each package for the task packages task-sparky-stereo-<role> (Daniel, 2026-10-07:
# "fine grain meta packages - like designer, gammer and such - all with stereo naming", "task
# packages as well - old debian user here"). Columns: package, roles (comma separated).
# Packages of apps.list not named here stay in sparky-stereo-desktop, the core everyone gets.
# Packages named here but in no list are role-only: they install with their task.
# Roles: gamer designer creator musician scientist student simmer
# Third column, for scientist and student only (Daniel: "for those edu and science - issue stereo
# and non-stereo meta and tasks - so people can install the missing non-stereo without conflicting
# with our stereo ones"): 3d = shows stereo on Sparky Stereo OS today (SOLUTIONS.md), into
# task-sparky-stereo-<role>; 2d = not yet, into task-sparky-<role>. A program moves to 3d when
# --- gamer: the games, gaming and runtimes lists go here whole (make-meta.py), plus:
# --- scientist: science and engineering (our stereo builds first)
# --- simmer: flight and racing simulators and their rigs
